fact: The Federal Ministry of Health's Director General of Health Information called for a full transition from paper-based to digital reporting through DHIS2, and participants recommended expanding DHIS2 to digitally link all health facilities.
The Federal Health Minister said national teams raised data reporting coverage from 13 percent at the onset of the crisis to more than 56 percent by the end of 2025.

The Ministries of Health and Digital Transformation launched phase one of a hospital management system programme, including an HMIS component, at Al-Nao hospital in Khartoum and the Gedaref hospital diagnostic centre, with gradual expansion to health institutions in other states planned.
A study of Sudan's health information systems found there is only one approved system for collecting health information, DHIS2.
